Title: Inquiry-to-Application Rate
Description: % of inquiries that submit a complete application. Benchmark: 15–30%.
Calculation Logic: Numerator: distinct applicants with funnel_stage_canonical in (applied, complete, admitted, deposited, enrolled, denied, withdrawn_app); denominator: all applicants including inquiry stage. Rounded to 4 decimal places; COALESCE to 0 on zero denominator. Column: inquiry_to_app_rate.
Known Caveats: COALESCE to 0 masks a zero-inquiry denominator; numerator counts denied and withdrawn_app applicants as having 'applied.'

Title: Application-to-Admit Rate
Description: Overall selectivity. Tracks admit rate by program, demographic, and geographic cohort.
Calculation Logic: Numerator: distinct applicants in (admitted, deposited, enrolled); denominator: distinct applicants in (complete, admitted, deposited, enrolled, denied). Rounded to 4 decimals; COALESCE to 0. Column: admit_rate.
Known Caveats: COALESCE to 0; denominator excludes inquiry and applied stages — only complete-or-further applications count toward the base.

Title: Admit-to-Yield Rate
Description: % of admitted students who enroll. Key driver of net tuition revenue planning.
Calculation Logic: Numerator: distinct applicants in (deposited, enrolled); denominator: distinct applicants in (admitted, deposited, enrolled). Rounded to 4 decimals; COALESCE to 0. Column: yield_rate.
Known Caveats: COALESCE to 0; yield numerator includes deposited students who have not yet formally enrolled.

Title: Deposit Conversions
Description: Deposits received vs. goal by term. Daily tracking critical in spring recruiting season.
Calculation Logic: Count of distinct applicants with funnel_stage_canonical in (deposited, enrolled) per program × entry term. Column: deposit_count.
Known Caveats: Enrolled students are included in deposit_count in addition to pure depositors; no goal/budget denominator in mart — vs-goal comparison requires external input.

Title: Stealth Applicant %
Description: % who applied with no prior inquiry. Indicates digital/brand reach vs. direct recruitment.
Calculation Logic: Numerator: distinct applicants with stealth_flag=true; denominator: distinct applicants in (applied, complete, admitted, deposited, enrolled, denied, withdrawn_app). COALESCE to 0. Column: stealth_app_pct.
Known Caveats: COALESCE to 0; stealth_flag definition depends on upstream CRM inquiry-linkage logic in fact_application.

Title: Application Completion Rate
Description: % of started applications that are fully submitted. Low rates flag UX or process issues.
Calculation Logic: app_complete_count (in complete, admitted, deposited, enrolled) divided by app_started_count (in applied, complete, admitted, deposited, enrolled, denied, withdrawn_app). No pre-computed rate column in mart; BI layer must divide app_complete_count / app_started_count.
Known Caveats: Completion rate not pre-computed — BI layer must derive from app_complete_count and app_started_count.

Title: Avg Academic Profile (GPA / Test)
Description: Mean/median GPA and test scores of admitted and enrolled cohorts, tracked year-over-year.
Calculation Logic: avg_hs_gpa: mean hs_gpa over enrolled applicants (enrolled_flag=true). avg_sat_total: mean sat_total where test_optional_flag=false. avg_act_composite: mean act_composite where test_optional_flag=false. All restricted to fact_application.enrolled_flag=true.
Known Caveats: test_optional_flag is hardcoded false on dim_applicant (TODO noted in SQL) — all enrolled applicants are currently included in test score averages regardless of test-optional status.

Title: Geographic Diversity Index
Description: % of enrollees from out-of-state, international, or target feeder markets.
Calculation Logic: geographic_diversity_index = 1 − SUM[(tier_count / total_enrolled)²] across three geo tiers: in_state, out_of_state, international. Range 0 (all from one tier) to ~0.67 (even split). Higher = more diverse. Column: geographic_diversity_index.
Known Caveats: in_state defined as state_code matching var('institution_state', 'MA') — hardcoded default; school-specific institution_state var must be set correctly at runtime.

Title: First-Gen Enrollment %
Description: % of enrolled new students identifying as first-generation college students.
Calculation Logic: Mean of (is_first_generation=true ? 1.0 : 0.0) over enrolled applicants joined to dim_student via person_id = student_id where is_current=true. COALESCE to 0. Column: first_gen_rate.
Known Caveats: SCD2 join to dim_student uses is_current=true rather than a term census-date range join (deferred per SQL comment); null for applicants where person_id is null on dim_applicant.

Title: Underrepresented Minority %
Description: Diversity composition of incoming class. Ties to Title III / institutional goals.
Calculation Logic: Mean of (is_urm=true ? 1.0 : 0.0) over enrolled applicants joined to dim_student via person_id = student_id where is_current=true. COALESCE to 0. Column: urm_rate.
Known Caveats: Same SCD2 caveat as First-Gen Enrollment %: is_current=true join; census date range join deferred; null for applicants without person_id.

Title: Counselor Caseload & Activity
Description: Contacts per counselor, visit volume, and event attendance vs. targets.
Calculation Logic: Count of distinct counselor_ref values for applicants with enrolled_flag=true per program × term. Column: active_counselor_count.
Known Caveats: Counts only counselors with at least one enrolled student; visit volume, event attendance, and contacts-per-counselor metrics are not in this mart.

Title: Cost Per Enrolled Student
Description: Total recruitment budget ÷ new enrolled headcount. Compare by channel and cohort.
Calculation Logic: Total recruitment budget (from GL — not in mart) divided by enrolled_count. Mart provides enrolled_count denominator only; numerator requires external GL cost source.
Known Caveats: Budget/cost numerator not in mart; full KPI requires GL integration.

Title: Application Processing Time
Description: Avg. days from complete application to decision letter. Affects competitor yield.
Calculation Logic: avg_days_app_to_complete: mean days from application start to complete status; avg_days_complete_to_decision: mean days from complete to admission decision; avg_days_inquiry_to_decision: mean days from first inquiry to decision. All averaged per program × term excluding nulls.

Title: CRM Engagement Score
Description: Composite of email opens, portal logins, campus visits from Slate.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — engagement_score_avg is hardcoded null::numeric in mart_admissions_funnel pending confirmation of stg_slate__applications.engagement_score.

Title: Year-over-Year Funnel Comparison
Description: Each funnel stage compared to same week/month of prior cycle. Reveals if class is building faster or slower.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of admissions funnel metrics — same inquiry_count, app_complete_count, admit_count, deposit_count, enrolled_count, inquiry_to_app_rate, admit_rate, yield_rate as mart_admissions_funnel base KPIs; one row per program × entry term × snapshot_week_num (weeks since Oct 1 of entry-year cycle start; negative = pre-Oct 1 activity).
Known Caveats: snapshot_week_num is calculated from current_date() at each weekly run; prior-year comparison requires BI-layer self-join on matching snapshot_week_num across different entry terms.

Title: Inquiry-to-App Conversion Trend
Description: Rolling 4-term trend of inquiry-to-application rate.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of Inquiry-to-Application Rate — same calculation as base KPI (inquiry_to_app_rate); one row per program × entry term × snapshot_week_num.

Title: Yield Rate Trend (5-Year)
Description: Admit-to-enroll yield tracked annually. Segment by program, geo, and merit band.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of Admit-to-Yield Rate — same calculation as base KPI (yield_rate); one row per program × entry term × snapshot_week_num.

Title: Deposit Pace vs. Prior Year
Description: Cumulative deposits by date within cycle overlaid with same date-range from prior 2 years.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of Deposit Conversions — deposit_count (applicants in deposited or enrolled stage) per program × entry term × snapshot_week_num; cumulative within each entry-term cycle.

Title: Application Volume Trend
Description: Total apps received per term over 5+ years, segmented by student type.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of application volume — app_started_count (applicants in applied/complete/admitted/deposited/enrolled/denied/withdrawn_app) and app_complete_count per program × entry term × snapshot_week_num.

Title: Stealth Applicant % Trend
Description: Year-over-year change in % of apps from students with no prior CRM contact.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of Stealth Applicant % — stealth_app_count and implied stealth_app_pct; same logic as base KPI per program × entry term × snapshot_week_num.

Title: Avg Academic Profile Trend
Description: Mean GPA and test scores of enrolled cohort tracked year-over-year.
Calculation Logic: NO CONFIDENT MATCH — snap_admissions_weekly contains funnel stage counts and conversion rates only; avg_hs_gpa, avg_sat_total, and avg_act_composite are not present in this snapshot.

Title: Geographic Diversification Trend
Description: Out-of-state and international % of enrolled class over 5 years.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — snap_enrollment_term has a null-stub residency_type column; geographic tier breakdown is not populated and no geographic_diversity_index column exists in this model.

Title: Feeder School Concentration Trend
Description: % of enrolled students from top 10 feeder high schools, tracked annually.
Calculation Logic: NO CONFIDENT MATCH — snap_admissions_weekly aggregates at program × entry term grain; feeder_concentration_index is in mart_admissions_class_profile (not snap_admissions_weekly) and no feeder school columns are present in the snapshot.

Title: Funnel Pipeline (Real-Time)
Description: Live funnel: inquiry → app → admit → deposit vs. prior year and goal.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws inquiry_count, app_started_count, app_complete_count, admit_count, deposit_count, enrolled_count, inquiry_to_app_rate, admit_rate, yield_rate, deposit_to_enroll_rate from mart_admissions_funnel at program × entry term grain. Needs manual definition.

Title: Yield Management
Description: Yield rate by program, aid sensitivity, competitor overlap, melt rate.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws yield_rate, deposit_count, enrolled_count, admit_rate from mart_admissions_funnel; aid sensitivity (yield by aid band) requires mart_aid_leveraging which is a stub; competitor overlap not in any current mart. Needs manual definition.

Title: Class Profile Builder
Description: GPA distribution, geo heat map, diversity metrics, feeder schools.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws avg_hs_gpa, avg_sat_total, avg_act_composite, test_optional_rate (academic profile); geographic_diversity_index, in_state_count, out_of_state_count, international_count (geographic); first_gen_rate, urm_rate (diversity); feeder_concentration_index from mart_admissions_class_profile at program × entry term grain. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: test_optional_flag is hardcoded false in mart_admissions_class_profile; hs_ceeb_code, hs_name, and hs_state are null stubs — feeder concentration index uses null CEEB codes.

Title: Counselor Activity Tracker
Description: Travel schedule, event ROI, territory performance.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws active_counselor_count from mart_admissions_funnel; travel schedule, event ROI, and territory performance require external data not in this mart. Needs manual definition.

Title: Cycle-over-Cycle Funnel Tracker
Description: Live current cycle paced against prior 2 years at same date.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws funnel stage counts and conversion rates (inquiry_count, app_complete_count, admit_count, deposit_count, enrolled_count, yield_rate) from snap_admissions_weekly; indexed by snapshot_week_num for same-week prior-cycle comparison. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: snapshot_week_num is weeks since Oct 1 of entry year; negative values indicate pre-Oct 1 cycle activity.

Title: 5-Year Funnel Trend Report
Description: Annual view of full funnel metrics from each of the last 5 entry terms.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws funnel counts and conversion rates from snap_admissions_weekly across the most recent 5 entry-term academic years. Needs manual definition.

Title: Territory Performance Over Time
Description: Counselor/territory yield and conversion rates across multiple cycles.
Calculation Logic: NO CONFIDENT MATCH — snap_admissions_weekly aggregates at program × entry term grain with no counselor or territory dimension; territory-level yield and conversion breakdown is not available in this mart.

Title: Section Fill Rate
Description: Enrolled ÷ capacity per section. Flag sections below 60% or over 90%.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — fill_rate is null stub in mart_section_utilization; requires section_capacity column not yet added to dim_course_section. enrolled_count per section is available.

Title: Waitlist Conversion Rate
Description: % of waitlisted students who ultimately enrolled. High rates signal under-supply.
Calculation Logic: waitlisted_count per section divided by (enrolled_count + waitlisted_count) per section; null when both enrolled and waitlisted are zero. Column: waitlist_pressure_rate.
Known Caveats: This is a demand pressure proxy, not true waitlist-to-enrollment conversion; L→R registration status transition tracking is not yet implemented — SQL comment notes 'Rename when true conversion logic is built.'

Title: Course Demand vs. Capacity Gap
Description: Unmet demand by department/course. Drives section expansion decisions.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — capacity_gap is null stub (section_capacity not yet in dim_course_section). total_demand_count (enrolled + waitlisted + dropped per section) is available as a raw-demand proxy.

Title: Credits per FTE
Description: Avg. credit hours per full-time equivalent student. Tied to tuition revenue and SAP.
Calculation Logic: total_registered_hours divided by fte per (program, student_type, load_status, term) group. FTE = IPEDS formula: UG registered_hours / 15; Graduate registered_hours / 9. Denominator uses NULLIF to avoid divide-by-zero. Column: credits_per_fte.
Known Caveats: CE enrollments appear as load_status='unknown' and contribute to total_registered_hours but use the undergraduate divisor (15) in the FTE calculation.

Title: Add/Drop Activity Rate
Description: Volume and timing of schedule changes by term.
Calculation Logic: Count of enrolled students with has_multiple_registration_attempts=true for the section divided by enrolled_count per section. Column: add_drop_rate.
Known Caveats: has_multiple_registration_attempts is a binary flag — a student who added/dropped once counts the same as one who did so multiple times; tracks students with churn, not raw transaction count.

Title: Withdrawal Rate
Description: % of enrolled students who fully withdraw mid-term.
Calculation Logic: Count of distinct student_id values with is_withdrawn=true divided by total distinct enrolled student_id values per (program, student_type, load_status, term) group. Column: withdraw_rate.
Known Caveats: Uses is_withdrawn (sentinel-cleaned); withdrawal_code '2' is excluded from withdrawal identification in upstream fact_student_term per SQL comment.

Title: Incomplete (I) Grade Rate
Description: % of students receiving incompletes. Tracks unresolved by semester and school.
Calculation Logic: Count of enrollment rows where dim_grade.is_incomplete=true divided by enrolled_count per section. Column: incomplete_rate.

Title: Time-to-Degree Progress
Description: Credits earned vs. credits needed at each enrollment milestone.
Calculation Logic: credits_remaining = max(credits_to_degree − cumulative_earned_hours, 0) per student. expected_credits_at_level maps UG class level to milestones: FR=0, SO=30, JR=60, SR=90 expected credits. credits_to_degree defaults to 120 (UG), 36 (GR), 18 (certificate) when not on dim_program.
Known Caveats: Default credits_to_degree values (120 UG, 36 GR, 18 cert) are used when dim_program.required_hours is not populated; transfer_attempted_hours and transfer_earned_hours are tracked separately but both are included in cumulative_earned_hours for remaining-credits computation.

Title: Graduation Rate (4yr / 6yr)
Description: IPEDS-reported completion rates. Critical for federal reporting and rankings.
Calculation Logic: yr4_grad_rate and yr6_grad_rate from mart_retention_cohort_summary. Columns: yr4_grad_rate (pct_graduated at years_since_entry=4), yr6_grad_rate (pct_graduated at years_since_entry=6). Pivots snap_cohort_milestone to IPEDS-standard grain.
Known Caveats: NSC not integrated; transfer-outs counted as stopped out. graduated_to_date uses dim_student.is_graduated (in-institution only) — will undercount graduates who transferred out and completed elsewhere.

Title: On-Track Graduation %
Description: % of enrolled students projected to graduate on time based on current credit pace.
Calculation Logic: yr4_grad_rate and yr6_grad_rate from mart_retention_cohort_summary. Columns: yr4_grad_rate (pct_graduated at years_since_entry=4), yr6_grad_rate (pct_graduated at years_since_entry=6). Pivots snap_cohort_milestone to IPEDS-standard grain.
Known Caveats: NSC not integrated; transfer-outs counted as stopped out. graduated_to_date uses dim_student.is_graduated (in-institution only) — will undercount graduates who transferred out and completed elsewhere.

Title: Classroom Utilization Rate
Description: Hours in use ÷ available hours per room. Drives capital and scheduling decisions.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — fill_rate is null stub and section_capacity not yet in dim_course_section; room dimension (hours-in-use / available-hours) not yet built per SQL comment.

Title: Faculty Teaching Load Compliance
Description: Actual vs. contracted credit hours per faculty.
Calculation Logic: NO CONFIDENT MATCH — mart_section_utilization has faculty_key per section row but dim_faculty join is broken pending FK resolution (SQL comment); contracted credit hours not modeled; actual-vs-contracted load cannot be computed.

Title: Registration Holds at Start of Term
Description: % of students with active holds blocking registration.
Calculation Logic: mart_registration_holds provides one row per active hold instance with is_active, blocks_registration, hold_code, and hold_description flags. Percentage of students with blocking holds requires joining to enrollment mart for a headcount denominator; not pre-aggregated in this mart.
Known Caveats: Percentage rate (% of students with active registration-blocking holds) requires joining enrolled headcount from mart_enrollment_census; mart_registration_holds is hold-level grain.

Title: Cohort Credit Accumulation Curve
Description: Avg cumulative credits by term number for each entering cohort.
Calculation Logic: avg_credits_cumulative = mean of cumulative_attempted_hours for students with is_enrolled_at_milestone=1 per (entry_term, measurement_term, program, cohort_type, years_since_entry) group. Column: avg_credits_cumulative.
Known Caveats: Average computed over enrolled survivors only (is_enrolled_at_milestone=1); students who stopped out before the measurement term are excluded — curve reflects retained cohort members, not the full original cohort.

Title: Term GPA Trend by Cohort
Description: Rolling avg term GPA for each cohort as they progress.
Calculation Logic: avg_cum_gpa = mean of cumulative_gpa for students enrolled at each fall measurement milestone per (entry_term, measurement_term, program, cohort_type) group. Column: avg_cum_gpa.
Known Caveats: Survivor bias — only students enrolled at the fall measurement term contribute; stop-outs (who may have lower GPAs) are excluded from the average.

Title: W/I Grade Rate Trend
Description: Withdrawal and incomplete grade rates per term over 5+ years by department.
Calculation Logic: w_rate = grade_w_count / enrolled_count per section (grade_code LIKE 'W%'); incomplete_rate = grade_i_count / enrolled_count per section (dim_grade.is_incomplete=true). Time-series trend derived by querying across multiple terms using term_acad_yr at department level.
Known Caveats: Both rates are at section grain; department-level trend requires BI-layer aggregation: sum grade_w_count and enrolled_count across sections grouped by department_code and term.

Title: On-Track Graduation % Trend
Description: % of students projected to graduate on time tracked across cohorts at same milestone.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of On-Track Graduation % — pct_on_track = sum(is_enrolled_at_milestone=1 AND on_track_gpa_flag=true) / sum(is_enrolled_at_milestone) per (entry_term, measurement_term, program, cohort_type) across years_since_entry values. Column: pct_on_track.
Known Caveats: on_track_gpa_flag is GPA-based only; survivor bias applies — enrolled survivors only contribute to the rate.

Title: Average Time-to-Degree Trend
Description: Actual semesters to graduation for completers, by cohort entry year.
Calculation Logic: NO CONFIDENT MATCH — snap_cohort_milestone tracks the proportion of a cohort graduated at milestone years (pct_graduated) but does not store average semesters elapsed for completers; a completer's exact graduation term relative to entry is not captured at this grain.

Title: Section Fill Rate Trend by Dept
Description: Rolling fill rates per department per term flagging sustained over/under-enrollment.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — fill_rate is null stub in mart_section_utilization (section_capacity not yet in dim_course_section); fill-rate trend cannot be computed.

Title: Waitlist Volume Trend
Description: Total waitlisted seats per term over time.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of waitlist volume — sum of waitlisted_count across sections grouped by department_code and term_acad_yr from mart_section_utilization. Column: waitlisted_count.

Title: Credits-per-FTE Trend
Description: Institution-wide avg credits per FTE per term. Declining trend signals part-time drift.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — fte is a null stub (null::numeric) in snap_enrollment_term; FTE computation requires fact_student_term load_status integration not yet joined in this model.

Title: Course Demand & Supply
Description: Section fill rates, waitlist heat map, demand gaps by dept.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws enrolled_count, waitlisted_count, total_demand_count, capacity_gap (null stub), fill_rate (null stub) from mart_section_utilization at section × term grain. Section fill rate and capacity gap unavailable until section_capacity is populated. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: fill_rate and capacity_gap are null stubs.

Title: Student Academic Progress
Description: Credit pace, W/I grade tracking, on-track % by cohort.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws registered_hours, cumulative_earned_hours, credits_remaining, on_track_gpa_flag, is_sap_compliant, withdrawal_code, cum_gpa_band, class_level_code from mart_academic_progress at student row grain. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: student_key is exposed at row level in mart_academic_progress — FERPA role-based access control required before client-facing delivery.

Title: Room & Faculty Utilization
Description: Room fill by time block, faculty load, scheduling conflicts.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — mart_section_utilization provides enrolled_count per section and faculty_key; fill_rate is null stub; dim_faculty join broken pending FK resolution; room-level hours-in-use not built. Mostly unavailable. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: fill_rate null stub; dim_faculty join broken; room utilization dimension not built.

Title: Registrar Operations
Description: Holds report, add/drop volume, transcript requests, IPEDS readiness.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws is_active, blocks_registration, blocks_transcript, hold_code, hold_description, placed_date, student_id from mart_registration_holds at hold-level grain. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: mart_registration_holds is hold-level grain; aggregate counts (% of students with holds) require joining enrollment mart for denominator.

Title: Cohort Academic Progress Curves
Description: Multi-cohort line chart: credit accumulation and GPA by term number.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws avg_credits_cumulative, avg_cum_gpa, pct_still_enrolled across years_since_entry values per (entry_term, program, cohort_type) from snap_cohort_milestone. Needs manual definition.

Title: Course Demand Trending
Description: Dept-level section fill rates and waitlist volumes over 4–6 terms.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws waitlisted_count, dropped_count, total_demand_count, add_drop_rate from mart_section_utilization grouped by department_code and term_acad_yr for multi-term trending. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: fill_rate is null stub.

Title: Tuition Discount Rate
Description: Institutional aid ÷ gross tuition billed. Industry benchmark: 40–55% at small privates.
Calculation Logic: discount_rate from mart_enrollment_census_ntr. Column: discount_rate = total_aid_disbursed / gross_tuition_billed per term. Grain: one row per (institution_id, term_key). DEMEAU synthetic data: account_value=0 → gross_tuition_billed=0, but production data will populate correctly.
Known Caveats: DEMEAU synthetic data has account_value=0 → gross_tuition_billed=0 in sbcust_rec, but model logic is complete and will activate correctly with real school billing data.

Title: Net Tuition Revenue per Student
Description: Gross tuition minus all institutional aid per enrolled FTE.
Calculation Logic: ntr_per_student from mart_enrollment_census_ntr. Column: ntr_per_student = net_tuition_revenue / enrolled_headcount per term. Denominator from mart_enrollment_census aggregated to (institution, term) grain.
Known Caveats: DEMEAU synthetic data has zero billing values; production data will populate correctly.

Title: Aid Budget vs. Actuals
Description: Institutional aid awarded vs. budgeted by term and cohort type.
Calculation Logic: ntr_per_student from mart_enrollment_census_ntr. Column: ntr_per_student = net_tuition_revenue / enrolled_headcount per term. Denominator from mart_enrollment_census aggregated to (institution, term) grain.
Known Caveats: DEMEAU synthetic data has zero billing values; production data will populate correctly.

Title: Avg Institutional Award per Student
Description: Mean grant/scholarship award by program, merit band, and need tier.
Calculation Logic: Sum of total_inst_offered (institutional aid rows only) divided by count of distinct students with total_inst_offered > 0 per (program, term). Column: avg_inst_award_per_recipient.
Known Caveats: Denominator is students with at least one institutional aid award — students with only federal or state aid are excluded from the denominator.

Title: Leveraging Efficiency
Description: Aid dollars spent per enrolled student vs. marginal net revenue gained.
Calculation Logic: merit_aid_total / total_inst_aid from mart_aid_leveraging per (term_key, program_key). Core leveraging metrics (merit vs. need split, aid band yield analysis) are functional. Columns: inst_aid_offered, merit_aid_total, need_based_aid_total, yield by aid_band. Unmet need and COA-based discount remain null until PowerFAIDS provides COA/EFC fields, but this does not block leveraging efficiency calculation.
Known Caveats: Unmet need metrics (coa_amount, efc_amount-based calculations) await PowerFAIDS deposit; core leveraging metrics functional.

Title: FAFSA Completion Rate
Description: % of enrolled/admitted students with a filed FAFSA.
Calculation Logic: merit_aid_total / total_inst_aid from mart_aid_leveraging per (term_key, program_key). Core leveraging metrics (merit vs. need split, aid band yield analysis) are functional. Columns: inst_aid_offered, merit_aid_total, need_based_aid_total, yield by aid_band. Unmet need and COA-based discount remain null until PowerFAIDS provides COA/EFC fields, but this does not block leveraging efficiency calculation.
Known Caveats: Unmet need metrics (coa_amount, efc_amount-based calculations) await PowerFAIDS deposit; core leveraging metrics functional.

Title: Verification Completion Rate
Description: % of selected students who complete verification within deadlines.
Calculation Logic: Count of distinct students with verification_status='complete' divided by count of students with verification_status in (selected, pending, complete, rejected) per (program, term). Column: verification_completion_rate.
Known Caveats: verification_status resolved per student-term by max_by with rank order: complete(5) > rejected(4) > pending(3) > selected(2) > not_selected(1) across all aid rows.

Title: SAP Compliance Rate
Description: % of aid recipients meeting Satisfactory Academic Progress. Required for Title IV.
Calculation Logic: Count of distinct students with sap_at_award='satisfactory' divided by count of students with sap_at_award IS NOT NULL per (program, term). Students without any SAP record are excluded from the denominator. Column: sap_compliance_rate.
Known Caveats: sap_at_award taken as the most recent non-null value (max_by on last_updated_date) across aid rows per student-term; satisfactory is the only compliant status — warning, probation, suspension, and termination are non-compliant.

Title: Cohort Default Rate (CDR)
Description: 3-year CDR on federal loans. >30% triggers federal sanctions.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — mart_ipeds_reporting returns zero rows; CDR requires stg_nsc__cohort_default_rates from NSC deposit not yet provisioned (SQL stub comment).

Title: R2T4 Return Rate
Description: Return of Title IV funds from withdrawn students. Timeliness and accuracy matter.
Calculation Logic: Count of distinct students with r2t4_flag=true divided by enrolled_headcount (total distinct students) per (program, term). Column: r2t4_rate.
Known Caveats: r2t4_flag set via boolor_agg across all aid rows per student-term — any single aid row with r2t4_flag=true triggers the student-level flag.

Title: Pell Grant Recipients %
Description: % of enrolled students receiving Pell. Indicator of served low-income population.
Calculation Logic: Count of distinct students with is_pell_recipient=true (at least one aid row with aid_type_code='GRANT_FED_PELL' via boolor_agg) divided by enrolled_headcount per (program, term). Column: pell_recipient_pct.
Known Caveats: is_pell_recipient uses hardcoded sentinel 'GRANT_FED_PELL' on dim_aid_type.aid_type_code — verify this matches the actual Pell fund code in the aid_type seed.

Title: Packaging Completion Rate
Description: % of enrolled students with finalized aid packages by start of term.
Calculation Logic: Count of students where booland_agg(packaging_status='packaged') = true (all aid rows packaged) divided by aided_recipient_count (students with any offered_amount > 0) per (program, term). Column: packaging_completion_rate.
Known Caveats: booland_agg requires ALL aid rows for a student to be packaged — a single unpackaged or pending row prevents the student from being counted as fully packaged.

Title: Unmet Need per Student
Description: Cost of attendance minus all aid and EFC. High unmet need correlates to stop-out risk.
Calculation Logic: Sum of unmet_need across all aid rows per student-term divided by count of students with at least one non-null unmet_need record per (program, term). Column: avg_unmet_need.
Known Caveats: unmet_need is null for JCX bridge rows until PowerFAIDS is live (SQL comment); avg_unmet_need will be null until has_powerfaids=true.

Title: Award Acceptance Rate
Description: % of offered aid packages accepted.
Calculation Logic: Sum of accepted_amount divided by sum of offered_amount per (program, term). COALESCE applied to prevent null. Column: acceptance_rate.
Known Caveats: Rate is based on dollar amounts (total_accepted / total_offered), not on a count of students who accepted; a student accepting 90% of a large award has more weight than one accepting 100% of a small award.

Title: Loan Borrowing Rate
Description: % of students taking federal loans; avg. borrowed amount.
Calculation Logic: Count of students with has_loan=true (at least one is_loan=true aid row via boolor_agg) divided by aided_recipient_count (students with offered_amount > 0) per (program, term). Column: loan_borrowing_rate.
Known Caveats: Denominator is aided recipients only — not all enrolled students; students with no aid record are excluded from both numerator and denominator.

Title: Tuition Discount Rate Trend (5-Year)
Description: The single most-watched financial aid metric by boards and bond rating agencies.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — discount_rate is null stub in snap_aid_term; computation requires gross_tuition_billed from fact_enrollment which is not yet joined in this model (SQL comment).

Title: Net Tuition Revenue Trend
Description: NTR per term and per enrolled student over 5+ years.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — NTR requires gross_tuition_billed from fact_enrollment joined to aid disbursements; neither net_tuition_revenue nor gross_tuition_billed are populated in snap_aid_term.

Title: Merit vs. Need Aid Split Trend
Description: Year-over-year shift in proportion of institutional aid awarded as merit vs. need-based.
Calculation Logic: Sum of offered_amount_total where is_merit_based=true divided by sum of offered_amount_total where is_institutional=true per term; derived by aggregating snap_aid_term rows (term × aid_type grain) filtering on is_merit_based and is_institutional flags.
Known Caveats: snap_aid_term is at term × aid_type grain; BI layer must aggregate across aid_type_key rows within a term to compute institution-wide merit-vs-need totals.

Title: Avg Award per Student Trend
Description: Average institutional award per enrolled student by program over time.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of offered_amount_per_recipient = offered_amount_total / recipient_count per (term × aid_type). For institution-wide institutional average: filter rows to is_institutional=true, sum offered_amount_total, divide by sum of recipient_count. Column: offered_amount_per_recipient.
Known Caveats: Per-recipient average is at (term × aid_type) grain; full institutional per-student average requires BI-layer aggregation across aid types within a term.

Title: Unmet Need Trend
Description: Avg unmet need per student over time. Rising unmet need is an early equity warning signal.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of unmet_need_avg per (term × aid_type) from snap_aid_term. Column: unmet_need_avg.
Known Caveats: unmet_need_avg is null until PowerFAIDS is live (SQL comment).

Title: Pell Recipient % Trend
Description: Annual change in % of enrolled students receiving Pell.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of Pell Grant Recipients % — pell_recipient_rate = recipient_count / enrolled_count for rows where is_pell_grant=true per term from snap_aid_term. Column: pell_recipient_rate.

Title: Cohort Default Rate Trend
Description: 3-year CDR tracked annually across cohorts.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — mart_ipeds_reporting returns zero rows; CDR historical trend requires NSC cohort default rate data not yet provisioned.

Title: Avg Student Loan Debt at Graduation Trend
Description: Mean cumulative federal loan borrowing at graduation by cohort.
Calculation Logic: NO CONFIDENT MATCH — snap_aid_term has per-term loan disbursement totals by aid type but no cumulative-to-graduation loan balance per cohort; graduation-level debt aggregation requires a cohort join not available in this model.

Title: Aid Budget Monitor

Discount rate requires mart_enrollment_census_ntr (available). Unmet need stubs do not block core budget monitoring. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: Unmet need metrics await PowerFAIDS; discount rate available from mart_enrollment_census_ntr.

Title: Compliance Status Board

Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — draws inst_aid_offered, merit_aid_total, need_based_aid_total, aid_band_yield_rate from mart_aid_leveraging at (term_key, program_key) grain. Discount rate requires mart_enrollment_census_ntr (available). Unmet need stubs do not block core budget monitoring. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: Unmet need metrics await PowerFAIDS; discount rate available from mart_enrollment_census_ntr.

Description: Aid band vs. yield, award sensitivity, merit vs. need split.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — aid band vs. yield, merit vs. need split from mart_aid_leveraging. Aid bands: band_zero ($0), band_1_5k ($1–$5k), band_5_10k ($5,001–$10k), band_10_15k ($10,001–$15k), band_15_20k ($15,001–$20k), band_20k_plus ($20,001+). Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: Unmet need metrics await PowerFAIDS deposit.

Title: Student Debt Load Report
Description: Avg loan by program, unmet need, borrower cohort CDR.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE — aid band vs. yield, merit vs. need split from mart_aid_leveraging. Aid bands: band_zero ($0), band_1_5k ($1–$5k), band_5_10k ($5,001–$10k), band_10_15k ($10,001–$15k), band_15_20k ($15,001–$20k), band_20k_plus ($20,001+). Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: Unmet need metrics await PowerFAIDS deposit.

Title: Discount Rate & NTR Trend
Description: Dual-axis: discount rate (line) and NTR per student (bar) over 7+ terms.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — discount_rate is null stub in snap_aid_term; NTR not populated.

Title: Student Debt Load Trends
Description: Avg loan debt at graduation by cohort entry year with CDR projection.
Calculation Logic: NO CONFIDENT MATCH — snap_aid_term has per-term loan disbursement and unmet need averages but no cumulative loan debt at graduation by cohort entry year; cohort-level debt aggregation requires cross-joining to snap_cohort_milestone which is not pre-computed.

Title: Headcount vs. Budget Target
Description: Total enrolled headcount vs. institutional budget plan.
Calculation Logic: headcount = count of distinct student_id values per (program, student_type, load_status, term) group. Budget target not in mart — headcount vs. goal comparison requires external budget input. Column: headcount.
Known Caveats: Budget target not in mart; CE enrollments appear as load_status='unknown'.

Title: FTE Enrollment
Description: Full-time equivalent enrollment (IPEDS definition).
Calculation Logic: fte = sum of (CASE WHEN academic_level='GRAD' THEN registered_hours / 9.0 ELSE registered_hours / 15.0 END) per (program, student_type, load_status, term) group per IPEDS formula. Column: fte.
Known Caveats: CE enrollments (load_status='unknown') use the undergraduate divisor 15 in the FTE calculation.

Title: New vs. Continuing Mix
Description: % of total enrollment that is new vs. continuing.
Calculation Logic: headcount grouped by student_type per term; student_type derived from class_level_code (FR → new_freshman; registration_status_code='TR' → transfer; SO/JR/SR → continuing; GRAD level → graduate). Percentage at BI layer: student_type headcount / sum(headcount) per term.
Known Caveats: student_type derivation includes TODO comment: 'confirm JCX registration_status_code values with RDT'; students with unmatched class_level_code default to 'continuing'.

Title: Enrollment by Program/School
Description: Headcount and FTE by college, department, and level.
Calculation Logic: headcount and fte aggregated by (program_key, program_name, academic_level, term). School/college rollup requires BI-layer grouping on program hierarchy; school_college is not exposed in mart_enrollment_census.

Title: Full-Time vs. Part-Time Split
Description: Shift toward part-time enrollment has significant FTE and revenue implications.
Calculation Logic: headcount grouped by load_status (full_time, part_time, unknown) per term; load_status derived from fact_student_term.load_status_derived. Percentage at BI layer.
Known Caveats: Students unmatched to fact_student_term appear as load_status='unknown'; CE enrollments also appear as 'unknown'.

Title: First-Year Retention Rate
Description: % of first-year students returning for year 2. Benchmark: 70–85% at small privates.
Calculation Logic: yr1_retention_rate from mart_retention_cohort_summary. Column: yr1_retention_rate (pct_still_enrolled at years_since_entry=1). Grain: one row per (institution_id, entry_cohort_year, program_key, cohort_type).
Known Caveats: NSC not integrated; transfer-outs counted as stopped out.

Title: Year-over-Year Retention Rate

Calculation Logic: yr1_retention_rate from mart_retention_cohort_summary trended across entry cohort years. Query across multiple entry_acad_year_int values to show year-over-year comparison.
Known Caveats: NSC not integrated; transfer-outs counted as stopped out.

Title: Stop-Out / Dropout Rate
Description: % leaving per term differentiated by voluntary leave vs. academic dismissal.
Calculation Logic: yr1_stop_out_rate, yr4_stop_out_rate, yr6_stop_out_rate from mart_retention_cohort_summary. Columns: yr1_stop_out_rate (pct_stopped_out at years_since_entry=1), yr4_stop_out_rate, yr6_stop_out_rate. Stopped-out students include transfer-outs until NSC integration.
Known Caveats: NSC not integrated; transferred_out is null stub — transfer-outs counted with stop-outs.

Title: At-Risk Student Count
Description: Students flagged by early alert criteria (GPA, attendance, financial holds).
Calculation Logic: Count of students with is_at_risk=true from mart_student_at_risk. Columns: is_at_risk, risk_tier (high/medium/none), risk_factor_count. Composite risk based on 4 dimensions: GPA (on_track_gpa_flag=false), SAP (is_sap_compliant=false), holds (has_registration_hold=true), financial clearing (financially_cleared=false). FERPA HIGH: student_key exposed at row level — restrict to Advisor/Registrar roles only.
Known Caveats: FERPA HIGH: student_key and student_id exposed at row level. KKM sign-off required before client-facing deployment.

Title: Re-Enrollment Rate (Continuing)
Description: % of currently enrolled students who register for the next term before term end.
Calculation Logic: Count of students with is_at_risk=true from mart_student_at_risk. Columns: is_at_risk, risk_tier (high/medium/none), risk_factor_count. Composite risk based on 4 dimensions: GPA (on_track_gpa_flag=false), SAP (is_sap_compliant=false), holds (has_registration_hold=true), financial clearing (financially_cleared=false). FERPA HIGH: student_key exposed at row level — restrict to Advisor/Registrar roles only.
Known Caveats: FERPA HIGH: student_key and student_id exposed at row level. KKM sign-off required before client-facing deployment.

Title: Projected vs. Actual NTR

Known Caveats: Forecast/predicted NTR not in mart; requires external budget data source for vs-goal comparison.

Title: Revenue per Enrolled Student
Description: Total tuition + fees revenue per headcount.
Calculation Logic: ntr_per_student from mart_enrollment_census_ntr. Column: ntr_per_student = net_tuition_revenue / enrolled_headcount per term. Same as row 60.
Known Caveats: DEMEAU synthetic data has zero billing values; production data will populate correctly.

Title: Enrollment Forecast Accuracy

Columns: headcount_total, cnt_urm_proxy, headcount_men, headcount_women (enrollment); yr4_grad_rate, yr6_grad_rate (completion) per institution × survey_year × lstudy_code. School-scoped via var('school_code'). Sources from stg_ipeds__fall_enrollment and stg_ipeds__graduation_rates.
Known Caveats: Peer group defined via dim_institution.is_merrimack_peer or is_anselm_peer flags; school-scoped at runtime.

Title: IPEDS Peer Comparison

School-scoped via var('school_code'). Sources from stg_ipeds__fall_enrollment and stg_ipeds__graduation_rates.
Known Caveats: Peer group defined via dim_institution.is_merrimack_peer or is_anselm_peer flags; school-scoped at runtime.

Description: CDS Section B/C/H data used in US News and other rankings.

Title: Total Headcount Trend (10-Year)

Known Caveats: headcount in snap_enrollment_term uses count(*) (row count from fact_enrollment), not count(distinct student_id); duplicate enrollment records for the same student-term would inflate counts.

Title: FTE Trend
Description: FTE per term alongside headcount to reveal part-time drift.
Calculation Logic: NOT YET COMPUTABLE — fte is a null stub (null::numeric) in snap_enrollment_term; FTE computation requires fact_student_term load_status integration not yet joined in this model.

Title: New vs. Continuing Mix Trend
Description: % split of new vs. continuing students per term over time.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of New vs. Continuing Mix — headcount grouped by student_type from snap_enrollment_term across multiple terms.
Known Caveats: In snap_enrollment_term, student_type = raw enrollment_status from fact_enrollment (JCX registration status code such as R, A, L); may not map to 'new_freshman'/'transfer'/'continuing' categories without further canonicalization.

Title: Enrollment by Program Trend
Description: 5-year headcount trend by school/college and degree level.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of Enrollment by Program — headcount by program_code and degree_level per term from snap_enrollment_term.
Known Caveats: school_college is a null stub in snap_enrollment_term; program-to-college mapping is not available in this model.

Title: First-Year Retention Rate Trend (10-Year)
Description: Most commonly scrutinized retention metric by accreditors and rankings.
Calculation Logic: Time-series view of First-Year Retention Rate — pct_still_enrolled (still_enrolled / original_cohort_size) at years_since_entry=1 (is_yr1_retention_milestone=true) per entry_term and cohort_type from snap_cohort_milestone across 10+ entry cohort years. Column: pct_still_enrolled.
Known Caveats: NSC not integrated; transferred_out is a null stub — students who transferred out are counted with stop-outs in pct_stopped_out, which can inflate apparent retention loss vs. IPEDS convention.

Title: Cohort Survival Curves
Description: % of each entering cohort still enrolled at each term milestone.
Calculation Logic: pct_still_enrolled = still_enrolled / original_cohort_size per (entry_term, measurement_term, program, cohort_type) for each years_since_entry from 1 to 8. Column: pct_still_enrolled.
Known Caveats: transferred_out is null stub — transfer-outs counted as stopped out. NSC not integrated.

Title: 4-Year and 6-Year Graduation Rate Trend

Calculation Logic: pct_graduated = graduated_to_date / original_cohort_size at is_4yr_graduation_milestone=true (years_since_entry=4) and is_6yr_graduation_milestone=true (years_since_entry=6) per entry cohort. Column: pct_graduated.
Known Caveats: graduated_to_date uses dim_student.is_graduated (in-institution only); will undercount graduates who transferred out and completed elsewhere. NSC not integrated — nsc_verified is false stub.

Title: Stop-Out Rate Trend by Demographic

Columns: pct_stopped_out, first_gen_stopped_out, urm_stopped_out.
Known Caveats: Demographic stop-out columns require KKM sign-off before client delivery (FERPA per SQL comment); NSC not integrated — transferred_out null, so stop-out count includes transfers.

Title: Re-Enrollment Rate Trend (Term-to-Term)

Known Caveats: Same enrollment_status filter redundancy as base metric (row 96) — new/transfer exclusion may not function as intended.

Title: Age Demographics × Enrollment Intensity

Description: Dashboard surfacing composite early-warning indicators intended to flag students at elevated stop-out risk before it happens.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE dashboard: earn_median_4yr / debt_at_completion by program and credential level from mart_scorecard_program_outcomes. Columns: earn_median_4yr (median earnings 4 years post-completion), debt_at_completion (median debt at graduation), earn_vs_national_pct (earnings vs. national median). Grain: one row per institution × cip_code × credential_level_code × data_year. Sources from stg_scorecard__field_of_study. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: is_suppressed = true when ED withheld values; ROI calculation skips suppressed rows.

Title: Program Earnings vs. Debt ROI
Description: Dashboard comparing typical post-graduation earnings to average student debt by program, an ROI view used in program-viability reviews.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE dashboard: earn_median_4yr vs. earn_median_4yr_national, earn_p25_4yr_national, earn_p75_4yr_national from mart_scorecard_program_outcomes. Benchmarks own-institution program earnings against College Scorecard national medians by CIP code and credential level. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: Peer ranks are NULL when <3 non-suppressed peers exist — avoids misleading "rank 1 of 1."

Title: Post-Graduation Earnings Benchmarking
Description: Dashboard benchmarking alumni earnings by program against peer-institution and national College Scorecard medians.
Calculation Logic: earn_median_pell_4yr vs. earn_median_nopell_4yr from mart_scorecard_program_outcomes by program. Earnings equity measure: gap = earn_median_nopell_4yr - earn_median_pell_4yr. No join to mart_aid_summary needed; Pell/non-Pell earnings already segmented in this mart. Column: earn_pell_vs_nopell_ratio (earn_median_pell_4yr / earn_median_nopell_4yr).
Known Caveats: is_suppressed flag applies; equity gap calculation skips suppressed program rows.

Title: Pell vs. Non-Pell Earnings Gap
Description: KPI tracking the gap in post-graduation earnings between Pell recipients and non-Pell recipients by program, an equity-in-outcomes measure.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE dashboard: debt_at_completion by program from mart_scorecard_program_outcomes, benchmarked against College Scorecard national and peer-group medians for matching CIP code and credential level. Columns: debt_at_completion, debt_vs_national_pct. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: Peer ranks NULL when <3 non-suppressed peers; is_suppressed flag applies.

Title: Student Debt Burden vs. Peers
Description: Dashboard comparing average student debt at completion to peer-institution and national benchmarks by program.
Calculation Logic: cdr_3yr from mart_scorecard_program_outcomes. Published 3-year cohort default rate from U.S. Dept. of Education via College Scorecard, ingested as-is (not computed). Column: cdr_3yr (borrowers who defaulted within 3 years / all borrowers who entered repayment). This is program-level CDR from Scorecard; row 67 CDR is institution-level from NSC (stub). Both are valid but serve different purposes.
Known Caveats: Program-level CDR from Scorecard; differs from institution-level CDR in row 67 (NSC-based, currently stub).

Title: Loan Default Rate (College Scorecard)
Description: KPI on the federal three-year cohort default rate on student loans as published via College Scorecard; sustained rates above roughly 30% trigger federal sanctions.
Calculation Logic: repayment_rate_3yr from mart_scorecard_program_outcomes. Share of a program's borrower cohort with declining or current loan balance within the federal measurement window, per Financial Value Transparency / Gainful Employment rules. Published via College Scorecard and ingested as-is. Column: repayment_rate_3yr.
Known Caveats: Externally published federal figure, not Ditteau-computed.

Title: Borrower-Based Repayment Rate (BBRR)
Description: KPI on the share of a program's borrower cohort making progress on loan repayment, part of the federal Financial Value Transparency and Gainful Employment framework.
Calculation Logic: earn_median_4yr / debt_at_completion from mart_scorecard_program_outcomes by program (inverse framing of federal debt-to-earnings ratio used in gainful employment determinations). Higher ratio = stronger program ROI. Column: earn_to_debt_ratio (computed as earn_median_4yr / NULLIF(debt_at_completion, 0)).
Known Caveats: is_suppressed flag applies; ratio calculation skips zero or suppressed debt values.

Title: Earnings-to-Debt Ratio by Program
Description: KPI on the ratio of typical program earnings to median student debt, the inverse framing of the federal debt-to-earnings threshold used to assess program value under gainful employment rules.
Calculation Logic: earn_median_4yr / debt_at_completion from mart_scorecard_program_outcomes by program (inverse framing of federal debt-to-earnings ratio used in gainful employment determinations). Higher ratio = stronger program ROI. Column: earn_to_debt_ratio (computed as earn_median_4yr / NULLIF(debt_at_completion, 0)).
Known Caveats: is_suppressed flag applies; ratio calculation skips zero or suppressed debt values.

Title: Net Tuition Revenue per FTE by Program/Major
Description: G/L tuition revenue net of institutional aid, divided by FTE, at program/major grain.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — no G/L source ingested. Numerator: G/L tuition and fee revenue net of institutional aid expense; denominator: FTE from mart_enrollment_census at program grain. Rates as decimals per platform convention.
Known Caveats: Overlaps existing rows 'Net Tuition Revenue per Student' (Financial Aid) and 'Revenue per Enrolled Student' (Enrollment Management), both targeting the unbuilt mart_enrollment_census_ntr — dedupe decision needed before this row is published. Small program cells risk re-identification; suppression threshold not yet set.

Title: Student Lifetime Value (LTV)
Description: Total realized revenue per student across their full enrollment span, net of institutional aid.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — no Student Accounts source formally ingested. Sum of AR billed-and-collected charges per student across all enrolled terms, net of institutional aid, joined to persistence history from dim_student (SCD Type 2 — full history required, do not filter is_current).
Known Caveats: Student-level financial history joined to enrollment record — FERPA gate, KKM sign-off required before any client-facing use. 'Realized' vs. 'projected' LTV is an unresolved definitional choice.

Title: Customer Acquisition Cost vs. LTV (CAC:LTV)
Description: Ratio of recruitment spend per enrolled student to that student's lifetime value.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — CAC numerator = total recruitment spend (A/P + G/L) divided by enrolled_count; denominator = Student Lifetime Value. Expressed as a decimal ratio.
Known Caveats: CAC component duplicates existing Admissions row 'Cost Per Enrolled Student' (Primary Source System 'Slate / GL'), which already asserts a GL source the platform does not ingest — reconcile the two rather than adding a parallel definition.

Title: Cost to Educate per Student by Program
Description: Fully-loaded instructional and support cost per FTE at program grain.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — G/L expense by fund/object code allocated to program, divided by program FTE.
Known Caveats: Blocked on a cost-allocation methodology decision (direct instructional cost vs. fully-loaded with overhead), which is an institutional policy question, not a data availability question. Method must be pinned per school or the KPI is not comparable across tenants.

Title: Contribution Margin by Academic Program
Description: Program revenue net of aid, less directly attributable instructional cost.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — (program billed revenue - institutional aid) - program instructional cost from G/L. Depends on the same allocation methodology as 'Cost to Educate per Student by Program'.
Known Caveats: Politically sensitive output — drives program discontinuation conversations. Recommend an explicit governance note in the KPI library on intended vs. non-intended use.

Title: Aid Leveraging ROI (Extended)
Description: Return on institutional aid measured against actual G/L revenue rather than modeled yield.
Audience: Financial Aid Director, CFO, VP Enrollment
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — extends existing aid leveraging logic by replacing modeled net revenue with realized G/L revenue per aid band. Aid offered x yield x realized revenue.
Known Caveats: Targets an existing mart, but mart_aid_leveraging is a stub and its current contract carries no G/L revenue column — this is a mart scope expansion, not a new-mart request. Sequence behind the existing mart_aid_leveraging build.

Title: Bad-Debt Risk Score with Academic Signals
Description: Composite risk score combining AR aging with SAP status, registration holds, and at-risk flags.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — composite of AR aging bucket, SAP status, registration hold count from mart_registration_holds, and is_at_risk / risk_tier from mart_student_at_risk (filter WHERE is_at_risk = TRUE; this mart has no is_current column).
Known Caveats: Highest-sensitivity row in the Finance set: predictive scoring that joins financial delinquency to academic-risk signals at student grain. FERPA gate plus a use-limitation question (risk of adverse action against students) — recommend explicit KKM review before this leaves draft status.

Title: Retention-Adjusted Revenue Forecast
Description: Forward revenue projection weighted by observed cohort persistence rates.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — projected NTR per continuing student x cohort persistence probability from snap_cohort_milestone, summed across cohorts.
Known Caveats: Stacks two unresolved dependencies: snap_cohort_milestone is unbuilt (critical path) and the NTR source mart is unresolved. Related existing row 'Revenue per Completed Student' is already flagged NO CONFIDENT MATCH for the same reason.

Title: Auxiliary Revenue per Bed / Occupancy
Description: Housing and auxiliary G/L revenue per available bed, with occupancy rate.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — auxiliary G/L revenue by fund divided by available beds; occupancy = beds occupied / beds available, expressed as a decimal.
Known Caveats: Requires a housing/residence-life source system, which is not in the platform's source inventory at all — this is a dependency outside the Finance domain and outside RDT's stated G/L / AR / A/P scope. Recommend deferring until a housing source is scoped.

Title: Discount Rate by Student Segment
Description: Institutional discount rate broken out by Pell status, first-generation status, and URM.
Audience: CFO, VP Enrollment, Financial Aid Director
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — institutional aid / gross tuition revenue, segmented by Pell recipient flag, first-gen flag, and URM grouping (Hispanic + Black + AIAN + NHPI + 2ormore). Decimal, not percentage.
Known Caveats: Scope flag: this row needs no G/L data. Both inputs (PowerFAIDS aid, demographic flags) are already in the platform, so it is arguably a Financial Aid row rather than a Finance row and is the nearest-term deliverable in this set. Validates against V-05 Race & Ethnicity. FERPA gate — KKM sign-off required.

Title: NACUBO Composite Financial Index (CFI), 5-Year Trend
Description: NACUBO/KPMG composite of primary reserve, viability, return on net assets, and net operating revenues ratios.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — four NACUBO ratios weighted and scaled to the published CFI formula, trended over five fiscal years.
Known Caveats: CFI inputs come from audited financial statements (net asset classes, change in net assets), not raw G/L transactions — the source is the annual audit, so an ingested G/L alone does not make this computable. Confirm the NACUBO formula version before publishing; weightings have been revised.

Title: Peer Benchmarking of Financial Ratios
Description: Institutional financial ratios compared against a selected peer set and national medians.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE, PROPOSED — blends internal ratio calculations with IPEDS Finance Survey peer data. Needs manual definition of the peer set per school.
Known Caveats: IPEDS feeds are not yet provisioned (mart_ipeds_reporting and mart_ipeds_fall_enrollment are both pending), so the external half of this KPI is blocked independently of the G/L half. IPEDS Finance Survey data lags roughly two years.

Title: Cash Flow Forecasting / Scenario Modeling
Description: Projected cash position under user-adjustable enrollment and expense scenarios.
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE, PROPOSED — rolling cash projection from G/L cash accounts, A/P commitments, and AR collection curves, with scenario levers on enrollment and expense growth. Needs manual definition.
Known Caveats: Interactive what-if modeling has no precedent in the current dashboard set and no scenario-input persistence layer exists in Streamlit in Snowflake as currently deployed. Treat as a distinct delivery pattern, not another read-only mart tile.

Title: Discount Rate Strategy Sensitivity Analysis
Description: Modeled net revenue outcomes across alternative discount rate strategies.
Audience: CFO, VP Enrollment, Financial Aid Director
Calculation Logic: COMPOSITE, PROPOSED — simulates yield and net revenue response to discount rate changes by segment. Needs manual definition of the elasticity assumptions.
Known Caveats: Simulation, not a query — outputs depend on assumed price elasticity, which is an institutional assumption rather than data. Assumptions must be surfaced in the dashboard, not buried, or the output reads as a measurement when it is a model.

Title: Multi-Year Budget Variance, Seasonality-Adjusted
Description: Budget-to-actual variance normalized for seasonality and trended across five or more fiscal years.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — (actual - budget) / budget by fund and department, normalized against the same fiscal period in prior years. Decimal, not percentage.
Known Caveats: Requires a stable multi-year chart of accounts; account restructures between fiscal years break the trend and need a crosswalk that no source currently provides.

Title: Days Cash on Hand, Enrollment-Adjusted
Description: Days of operating expense covered by unrestricted cash, adjusted for enrollment-cycle timing.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — unrestricted cash / (annual operating expense / 365), adjusted for deposit-season and aid-disbursement timing from the admissions funnel.
Known Caveats: The enrollment adjustment is the differentiating element and the least defined; the unadjusted ratio is Category 3 in substance.

Title: Budget vs. Actual by Fund/Department
Description: Current fiscal year budget-to-actual comparison by fund and department.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — actual G/L amount vs. budget amount by fund_code and department, current fiscal year, with variance as a decimal.
Known Caveats: ERP-native. Include only as a consistency/access convenience; do not position as differentiated capability. Feasibility is client-specific and depends on fund/object-code cleanliness in each ERP instance.

Title: AR Aging (30/60/90/120+)
Description: Student accounts receivable balances bucketed by days outstanding.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — outstanding AR balance grouped into 30/60/90/120+ day buckets from transaction_date.
Known Caveats: ERP-native at aggregate grain, but student-level drill-down makes balances an education record under FERPA — KKM gate applies to any drill-through, not to the aggregate tile. Partial reachability: sbcust_rec already feeds mart_enrollment_census_ntr (see governance flag).

Title: A/P Aging
Description: Accounts payable balances bucketed by days outstanding.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — outstanding payables grouped into standard aging buckets from invoice date.
Known Caveats: ERP-native. No student data involved — lowest governance burden in the Finance set.

Title: Days Payable Outstanding (DPO)
Description: Average days taken to pay vendor invoices, trended.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — (average accounts payable / cost of goods or operating expense) x days in period.
Known Caveats: ERP-native as a point-in-time figure; the trend is the only warehouse-added value.

Title: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
Description: Average days to collect student account receivables, trended.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — (average AR / billed revenue) x days in period.
Known Caveats: ERP-native as a point-in-time figure. Higher-ed AR is term-cyclical, so a rolling DSO is misleading without term anchoring — recommend reporting by term rather than by month.

Title: % Invoices Paid On Time
Description: Share of vendor invoices paid on or before terms.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — invoices paid on or before due date / total invoices paid. Decimal, not percentage.
Known Caveats: ERP-native. Value is distribution, not computation — the metric is typically trapped in A/P-only reporting.

Title: 3-Way Match / Invoice Exception Rate
Description: Share of invoices failing PO, receipt, and invoice match, trended.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — exception count / total invoices processed. Decimal, not percentage.
Known Caveats: ERP-native. Depends on the client actually operating a PO/receiving process; not applicable at institutions that pay on invoice alone.

Title: Early Payment Discount Capture Rate
Description: Share of available early-payment discounts actually captured.
Calculation Logic: PROPOSED — discounts captured / discounts available, by dollar value. Decimal, not percentage.
Known Caveats: ERP-native. Requires vendor terms to be recorded structurally; free-text terms fields make the denominator unreliable.
